scope: Serious research only; no website integration, PDF, old-stage reruns or larger-memory controllers
temporalFamily: All at-most-four-state edge-emitting stochastic controllers (pi,K_H,K_V), nonnegative, (K_H+K_V)1=1, independent of outcomes and anchors
certification: Exact rational finite-prefix open-loop upper envelopes. These relax the complete temporal family to arbitrary random infinite orientation words; no parameter-grid optimality claim.
temporalFeasibleSearch: Exploratory <=2-state rational transition grid; genuinely edge-emitting stochastic examples with <=4 states; exact evaluation of selected points. The grid is a lower-bound pool, never the complete stochastic null.
feedbackSearch: All universally-live <=2-state controllers plus systematic structural invariant representatives of <=4-state operational classes, exact tiny-system evaluations; no Monte Carlo packing survey
operationalScope: Deterministic realizations, full action/outcome/occupancy process, stop only at geometric jam. Universal fixed-k RSA family theorem and complete existing <=4-state structural catalogue quotient; stochastic realization minimality kept separate.
witnesses: Exact product-state reachability. Smallest checked geometry explicitly distinguished from analytically guaranteed finite witness bound.
rareBranch: New layered forest valuations of higher moments; unknown-entry splitting estimator if a provably unbiased implementation succeeds. Any finite benchmark is an implementation diagnostic, not RSA confirmation.
researchDiscipline: New exact claims use independent implementation/certificates. No p-value search, no old-source changes, no local optimum called global and no process-law gap inferred to be an objective gap. Deferred problems are retained.
